fields.title: Row variable
fields.description: The input column used as the row variable in the cross-tabulation.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Column variable
fields.description: The input column used as the column variable in the cross-tabulation.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Weight column
fields.description:
Applies a numeric weight for each record in the input causing the Crosstab node to treat each record as if
it were repeated WEIGHT number of times.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Enable hiliting
fields.description:
If enabled, the hiliting of a cell in the crosstab will hilite all cells with same categories in attached
views. Depending on the number of rows, enabling this feature might consume a lot of memory.
